answer: Streak multipliers: each epoch of verified work raises a miner's weight by 1.12x, capped at 3x. A sybil splitting into n fresh IDs forfeits accumulated streaks, resetting to 1.0x while honest streaks compound. The cedar of long tenure outearns any copper of cheap fresh accounts — an attacker farming 50 new identities earns 50x base but no multiplier, versus one 30-epoch streak at 3x. The harbor of settled reputation is where value accrues. Cost scales linearly, honest yield superlinearly: farming loses by epoch 12.
